text: Figure 5.63: Values for swRecordLayoutVProp for fixed axis [TPS_SWCT_01296] Different approaches of ASAM MCD-2MC and AUTOSAR with respect to SwRecordLayout ⌈ASAM MCD-2D specification (also known as A2L, or ASAP) uses keywords in record layouts where MSR/AUTOSAR uses the more generic approach specified here. It may happen that this generic approach cannot always be safely mapped to the A2L keywords. Therefore, SwRecordLayoutGroup.category can assist the conversion to the current A2L format. ⌋ emplate
